workItem: Implement the OPS-owned reproducible User-Lifecycle harness and provider-test package for Supabase Local/Mailpit, Stripe sandbox/Test Clocks, durable webhook/outbox processing, stable user-id subscription projection and server-side entitlement readback without creating parallel authorities or mutating Production.
workItemDE: Den OPS-eigenen reproduzierbaren User-Lifecycle-Harness und das Provider-Testpaket fuer Supabase Local/Mailpit, Stripe Sandbox/Test Clocks, dauerhafte Webhook-/Outbox-Verarbeitung, stabile User-ID-Subscription-Projektion und serverseitigen Entitlement-Readback implementieren, ohne parallele Authorities oder Production-Mutationen zu erzeugen.
ownerRole: Primary owner of Controlled Implementation plus provider/runtime evidence within Production Operations boundaries
authorityGuard: package.json#version remains sole platform-version authority. Existing Auth, Stripe inbox, outbox and entitlement contracts remain authoritative. The candidate changes only the existing subscription-projection function through a normal migration; it creates no second Auth/Billing/EventMesh/Release/Production authority, no Security self-verification, no Compliance approval and no Production mutation.
providerGuard: The connected Supabase project and Render are read-only correlation/evidence inputs for this work item. The new Supabase migration is not applied by this work item. Provider tests target Supabase Local/Mailpit and Stripe sandbox/test mode only; secrets, tokens, cookies, service-role keys and full payment data are excluded from evidence.
foreignWork: CAPITAL-AI-FE consumes the stable OPS lifecycle test contract and owns presentation/shared consumer remediation after this package
CAPITAL-AI-SEC retains independent Security assurance and VERIFIED/CLOSED authority
CAPITAL-AI-GOV retains final cross-owner evidence correlation
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment. PR creation remains subject to final exact-snapshot Human/Owner approval under the current CAPITAL-AI-OPS project instructions. Production deployment/mutation is not authorized by this work item.
